name: A 3480-Concept Two-Row Relative Extension
definition: Use the certified $42/22$ pair $O\subset P\subset Q_6$ and its $1364$-concept rectangular obstruction. With $P'=\pi_0P$ and $O'=\pi_0O$, put $C=(P'\times O)\cup(O'\times P)$, $D_0=P'\times P$, and $D_1=(Q_5\times O)\cup(O'\times P)$, and use these as the two enlarged rows.
parameters: $|C|=892$, $|D_0|=1092$, $|D_1|=1024$, and the output has $3480$ concepts in dimension $13$.
properties: Both enlarged rows strictly contain $C$. A certified relative order deletes the $132$ words of $D_1\setminus C$ and leaves the cornerless $3348$-concept one-row obstruction. The full output is therefore an ample pc-minimal obstruction. Its $18$ corners are exactly the row corners predicted by two-row corner factorization, and all $39$ elementary proper-minor orders are certified.
